question.text: 'Saraswati Cat III Open-Ended AIF' has assets of INR 500 crore. Sponsor commitment is 5% of corpus with a statutory cap. What is the sponsor's contribution?

answer.text: INR 10 crore (lower of 5% of INR 500 cr = INR 25 cr, or INR 10 crore)

explanation.text: The Logic: Cat III rule: LOWER of 5% of corpus or INR 10 crore. 5% of INR 500 cr = INR 25 cr; INR 10 cr is lower. Sponsor contributes INR 10 crore. The Trap: Option B ignores the INR 10 cr cap. Option C applies an incorrect percentage. Option D applies Cat I/II rule. Cross-Exam Context: Direct variant of Q17 — XIX-C tests the 'lower of' logic repeatedly across different corpus sizes. Manager's Pro-Tip: If your Cat III sponsor is capital-constrained, structure the sponsor commitment as a first-loss tranche of INR 10 cr instead of pari-passu — it signals better alignment and may justify a higher carry split.
